trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Durg (Case No. 932/2019)
facts_of_case: Marriage between the parties was solemnized in 2012 and a son was born. The respondent-husband allegedly uttered abusive words and tried to harass the petitioner-wife. She filed an application for custody of the child under Sections 7 & 12 of the Guardians and Wards Act, 1809 before the learned Family Court, Jagdalpur.

legal_principles.principle: The ends of justice should demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceeding.
legal_principles.held: The cardinal principle for exercise of power under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure is that the ends of justice should demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceeding.

legal_principles.principle: In matrimonial matters, the Courts have to take into consideration the economic soundness of both the parties, the social strata of the spouses and their behavioural pattern.
legal_principles.held: In matrimonial matters, wherever Courts are called upon to consider the plea of transfer, the Courts have to take into consideration the economic soundness of both the parties, the social strata of the spouses and their behavioural pattern, their standard of life prior to the marriage and subsequent thereto and the circumstances of both the parties in eking out their livelihood and under whose protective umbrella they are seeking their sustenance to life.

legal_principles.principle: Generally, it is the wife's convenience which must be looked at while considering transfer.
legal_principles.held: Given the prevailing socioeconomic paradigm in the Indian society, generally, it is the wife's convenience which must be looked at while considering transfer.

legal_principles.principle: When two or more proceedings are pending in different Courts between the same parties which raise common question of fact and law, they should be tried together by the same Judge.
legal_principles.held: Further, when two or more proceedings are pending in different Courts between the same parties which raise common question of fact and law, and when the decisions in the cases are interdependent, it is desirable that they should be tried together by the same Judge so as to avoid multiplicity in trial of the same issues and conflict of decisions.

outcome.final_order: The transfer petition was allowed and the proceedings in Case No. 932/2019 pending before the Principal Judge, Family Court, Durg were stayed.
